project.name: FIFAWorldCup
project.description: A model of a FIFA World Cup tournament, including teams, matches, stadiums, and tournament personnel.

0c39790c-38a3-458d-8a27-e20f66d7c9d3.name: Match_inv_DifferentTeams
0c39790c-38a3-458d-8a27-e20f66d7c9d3.constraint: context Match inv Match_inv_DifferentTeams: self.homeTeam <> self.awayTeam

cb53a0c2-13cc-436d-bb56-1690f1186627.name: Match_inv_ValidScores
cb53a0c2-13cc-436d-bb56-1690f1186627.constraint: context Match inv Match_inv_ValidScores: self.homeScore >= 0 and self.awayScore >= 0

409c8842-39a2-41c2-bb74-a3c1414d4aec.name: Tournament_inv_HasFinal
409c8842-39a2-41c2-bb74-a3c1414d4aec.constraint: context Tournament inv Tournament_inv_HasFinal: self.matches->exists(m | m.stage = MatchStage::FINAL)

56d5e5f9-1a2d-44af-9839-0d52b215e302.name: Player_inv_ValidShirtNumber
56d5e5f9-1a2d-44af-9839-0d52b215e302.constraint: context Player inv Player_inv_ValidShirtNumber: self.shirtNumber > 0 and self.shirtNumber <= 99

91728726-7b59-459b-adf5-2d6def70772f.name: Team_inv_UniqueShirtNumbers
91728726-7b59-459b-adf5-2d6def70772f.constraint: context Team inv Team_inv_UniqueShirtNumbers: self.players->forAll(p1, p2 | p1 <> p2 implies p1.shirtNumber <> p2.shirtNumber)
